integrity: The theorem is proved by exact spectral calculation and a monotone polynomial; accompanying tests use independent moment/resolvent calculation. No external independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite equal-rate directed four-state promoter, one active state, Poisson transcription, independent exponential transcript lifetimes; not general feedback, bursts, cells or nonuniform cycles. Finite tests corroborate but do not establish the all-parameter theorem. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp feedback-free spectral resonance threshold in a four-state cyclic promoter
